summary.text: Mike A. Cherry is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 74th District, which covers part of Chesterfield County and the city of Colonial Heights, and has served since 2022.
Cherry sits on the House committees on Education, Health and Human Services and Privileges and Elections.

paragraphs.text: Mike A. Cherry was born in Rocky Mount, NC, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Cherry's education as Liberty University (B.S., Religion, 2010); Regent University (M.Ed., School Leadership, 2015; EdS, School Leadership, 2017).
The profile gives Cherry's occupation as pastor.
The profile lists Cherry's military service as USAF (Retired Master Sergeant, 1991-2011).
Cherry's listed memberships and affiliations include Life Church.
